const r = await tools.exec_command({"cmd":"python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,sys
root=Path('.')
manifest_path=root/'.ai/task/repair-w65-20261004/PACK-MANIFEST.json'
m=json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
out=root/'evidence/quality/repair-window-65-20261004/orchestration'
errors=[]; existing_same=existing_diff=missing=0
for e in m['files']:
    s=root/e['source']; d=out/e['relative_destination']
    if not s.is_file(): errors.append(f'MISSING SOURCE {s}'); continue
    b=s.read_bytes(); h=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
    if h != e['sha256'] or len(b) != e['bytes']:
        errors.append(f'SOURCE MISMATCH {s}: {h} {len(b)} expected {e["sha256"]} {e["bytes"]}')
    if d.exists():
        if d.is_file() and d.read_bytes()==b: existing_same+=1
        else:
            existing_diff+=1; errors.append(f'EXISTING TARGET DIFFERS {d}')
    else: missing+=1
print(f'pack source entries={len(m["files"])} existing_same={existing_same} existing_diff={existing_diff} missing={missing}')
# Required publication sources
req_task=['PUBLICATION-SCOPE.md','CATALOG-CHANGE-VERIFICATION.json','MIGRATION-HOST-VERIFICATION.json','TRANSLATION-COMMIT.json','SCOPE.json','SOURCE-CLAIMS.json','NEW-TARGETS.json']
req_task += sorted(p.name for p in (root/'.ai/task/repair-w65-20261004').glob('ADJUDICATION-*.json'))
req_art=['HOST-SUPPLEMENT-CLAIMS.json','HOST-EXACT-DIFF.json']
req_chain=['window65-20261004-publish-chain.log','window65-20261004-publish-chain-timing.json','window65-20261004-migration.json','window65-20261004-migration-timing.json']
for p in [*(root/'.ai/task/repair-w65-20261004'/n for n in req_task),*(root/'.artifacts/i18n/repair-w65-20261004'/n for n in req_art),*(root/'.artifacts/i18n/repair-window'/n for n in req_chain)]:
    if not p.is_file(): errors.append(f'MISSING PUBLICATION SOURCE {p}')
print('publication attachments expected:',len(req_task)+len(req_art)+len(req_chain), req_task+req_art+req_chain)
print('candidate files:', sum(1 for p in (root/'.artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window65-20261004-candidate-catalog').rglob('*') if p.is_file()))
for p in sorted((root/'evidence/quality/repair-window-65-20261004').rglob('*')):
    if p.is_file(): print('existing window file',p)
if errors:
    print('\n'.join(errors)); sys.exit(1)
print('PRECHECK OK')
PY
